scope: Three public-space dossiers testing knowledge circulation, designed ecological stewardship and ground-level grid behavior; episodic programs never become assumed route windows.

sources.supports: Twenty-year San Borja operation, design-history exhibition, civic hall and guided public route as of 2026-03-28.
Current reading, study, collection-consultation and outdoor-terrace services; photography conditions remain unverified.
Permanent lagoon cleaning and ecological-care work documented 2026-05-28.
2026 heritage-tree route and an approximately 388-year-old olive; event timing does not establish a recurring tour.
Current maintenance of benches, bridge, posts, lagoon and Constancio Bollar promenade; more than 1,600 olives and community use.

sources.publisher: C40 Cities / Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima / PROLIMA
sources.supports: Pedestrian-priority grid, controlled vehicle entries and intersection-scale operating logic.
Regular vehicle circulation restored 2026-06-21 after temporary restrictions; present conditions still require same-day verification.
Removal of overhead cables across more than 50 blocks changed façade and intersection legibility; coverage varies by block.

contradictions: The 2026 anniversary exhibition proves active institutional interpretation but not its availability on a future visit.
Published reading and terrace services do not establish architectural-photography permission or a predictable occupancy density.
composition_questions: Can a reader's movement from civic hall toward study room or terrace make the building's promise of public knowledge access visible?
Which security barrier, display panel, bright doorway or overlapping visitor would break the hall–threshold–destination sequence?
Does moving from the emblematic front to a lateral interior/terrace threshold reveal knowledge circulation better than widening the façade?

source_truth.answer: The Biblioteca Nacional's San Borja headquarters opened in 2006 and remains an operating national institution for preservation, reading, research and cultural access.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A monumental civic hall distributes users toward exhibition, reading, research and preservation functions, making controlled public access part of the building's order.

current_life.answer: Readers study, consult collections and use an outdoor terrace while exhibitions and guided routes activate the hall; exact access on the visit date must be checked.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, register, orient, climb, read, consult, study and pause are current. The strongest verb is crossing from monumental collective space into focused reading.

architectural_causality.answer: Hall, controlled thresholds, stairs, galleries, reading rooms and terrace progressively convert civic arrival into concentrated knowledge work.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Frontal monumentality and empty lateral mass dominate. The underrepresented relation joins a real reader's route to the interior hierarchy and terrace edge.

light_material_geometry.answer: Diffuse hall light can separate deep thresholds and concrete/stone planes; terrace daylight can stage the transition from enclosed archive to public horizon.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public hall diagonal, approved reading-room threshold and terrace approach. Start 35 mm for spatial sequence, 50 mm for reader/device causality and 85 mm only across an authorized layered axis.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Confirm current entry and photography rules, never photograph collection material or identifiable readers without consent, remain outside circulation and use exterior fallback if interior work is declined.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only if institutional architecture visibly turns public arrival into reading or study. Monumental façade, exhibition documentation or generic reader scale fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Authorized public-hall diagonal aligning entrance, vertical circulation and deeper threshold
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude security clutter, clipped stairs and bright exit signs
A_STRUCTURE.access_ethics: Public area and current rules only

B_HABITAR.position: Approved side of reading-room or terrace threshold
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Reader passes from collective route into focused study plane
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate figure from door and furniture
B_HABITAR.access_ethics: No readable documents or identifiable faces

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Approved lateral interior edge looking from study circulation toward terrace, away from front façade
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Reader crosses a compressed sequence of threshold, table and outdoor edge
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No institutional logo or exhibition panel dominates

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Public/approved side angle across deep opening and wall plane
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Single silhouette crosses one light band

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Approved hall edge combining arrival, ascent and reading/terrace destination
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: Caption must explain public knowledge access

contradictions: Municipal language calls maintenance permanent, but no repeatable worker schedule supports a route promise.
The 2026 heritage-tree launch proves a route concept, not permanent guides, signs or group activity.
composition_questions: Can a maintained path, bridge or lagoon edge show that centuries-old vegetation functions as designed civic infrastructure rather than picturesque nature?
Which parked car, wedding portrait, branch overlap or blown water reflection would hide the path–care–community relationship?
Does moving to the maintenance/path edge reveal stewardship and daily circulation better than changing focal length from the iconic lagoon panorama?

source_truth.answer: Bosque El Olivar is a protected San Isidro urban forest and civic landscape with more than 1,600 olive trees, lagoon, paths, bridge and community facilities.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The inherited grove was preserved and equipped as connected ecological, walking and cultural public space rather than an isolated garden object.

current_life.answer: People walk, meet and learn while municipal teams clean the lagoon, prune, conserve habitat and interpret heritage trees; exact activity cadence remains field evidence.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Walk, sit, read, guide, observe, clean, prune and protect are credible. Care labor most strongly contradicts the illusion of untouched nature.

architectural_causality.answer: Promenade, path junctions, benches, bridge, lagoon edge and cultural buildings channel movement and make the living grove usable as public infrastructure.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Lagoon panoramas, wedding portraits and isolated ancient trunks dominate. The underused frame connects maintenance or learning to the designed public edge.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa simplifies foliage while filtered light separates rough trunks, water edge and path; hard noon produces clutter unless shadows reveal the circulation structure.

position_then_optics.answer: Test lagoon-maintenance edge, Constancio Bollar promenade junction and heritage-tree/path alignment. Start 35 mm for civic landscape, 50 mm for care/device and 85 mm only for distant layers retaining path context.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Visit without assuming work or tours, protect habitat and path flow, avoid nesting wildlife and identifiable children, and cap event waiting at 20 minutes before using meaningful absence.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when designed edges and present care make the old grove's civic life visible. Beautiful trees, reflections or portraits without causal infrastructure fail.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public diagonal aligning promenade, bridge/lagoon edge and mature trunks
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude cars, portrait crews and clipped trunks

B_HABITAR.position: Respectful public distance across lagoon/path maintenance interface
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Care worker acts while walker uses the maintained edge
B_HABITAR.kill_trigger: Worker becomes documentary subject without architecture

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Low lawful path angle placing heritage trunk between route marker/edge and current walker
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Walker rounds trunk along constrained path
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No isolated tree portrait or lagoon postcard

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Distant path angle across rough trunk, maintained water edge and bridge

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public oblique combining centenary trunk, maintained civic edge and two user states
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.wait_trigger: Care and daily use share one designed edge

contradictions: The June 2026 restoration of regular traffic proves reversibility, not the current operation of any chosen intersection.
Cable removal covers many blocks but cannot be generalized to every axis; the final crossing and safe standing point remain unselected.
composition_questions: Can one safe ground-level intersection reveal the orthogonal grid through axial depth and perpendicular human/vehicle flows without a map?
Which vendor canopy, parked vehicle, crowd overlap or remaining cable field would collapse the four-direction reading?
Does changing corners or camera height expose crossing geometry more clearly than using a wider lens from the first corner?

source_truth.answer: The Damero is Lima's historic orthogonal block and street system; the scene unit is one verified intersection, not the entire center or Plaza Mayor.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Perpendicular streets, repeated blocks and axial routes organized movement, parcels, institutions, commerce and the civic center through a legible grid.

current_life.answer: Walking, deliveries, commerce, transit and controlled vehicle access still negotiate the grid; temporary restrictions demonstrate that intersection behavior changes with operation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, wait, turn, sell, deliver, drive and police are credible. The decisive event is perpendicular release of flows that makes the grid visible at street level.

architectural_causality.answer: Corner lines, repeated façades, crosswalks, controlled entries and long vanishing axes channel bodies into alternating orthogonal movements.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Plaza monuments, balconies and elevated grid diagrams dominate. The underused frame tests a cleaned or changing intersection where ground flows reveal the plan.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can suppress signage and cable clutter; brief sun can cast orthogonal façade/corner shadows, but light is useful only when two street axes remain legible.

position_then_optics.answer: Scout all four lawful corners and any safe setback before choosing the crossing. Start 35 mm for both axes, 50 mm when an axial endpoint strengthens order and reject 85 mm if it erases the perpendicular street.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify current traffic restrictions, works, crowd and safe stopping point; never enter carriageway or block commerce, avoid identifiable vulnerable people and cap one signal-cycle test at 20 minutes.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only if perpendicular built lines visibly cause present crossing/turning. Heritage façades, dense street life or a map-dependent argument fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Safest verified corner/setback aligning two perpendicular street axes and repeated façades
A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Brief clear signal interval reveals both axes
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude dominant sign, parked van and clipped corner
A_STRUCTURE.fallback: 50 mm single-axis endpoint plus visible cross street

B_HABITAR.position: Verified wide sidewalk corner facing perpendicular crosswalk/turning lines
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Pedestrians cross one axis as delivery/turning movement occupies the other

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Non-monumental cleaned intersection edge with long façade lines and visible cross street
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Figure turns ninety degrees at corner

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Safe corner where lateral sun or cleared sky reveals two façade planes

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Verified setback showing controlled entry, perpendicular axes and active corner
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Waiting, crossing and turning occupy distinct grid planes
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Preserve axial depth and clear corner
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.wait_trigger: Three states align within one signal cycle
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: Caption/map must rescue the damero idea
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.access_ethics: Current operation and public safety first
